title: Exploring the Mechanisms of the Ferroptosis-Related Gene TGFBR1 in Autoimmune Uveitis Based on Machine Learning Models
summary: Machine-learning gene selection and experimental autoimmune-uveitis assays identify TGFBR1 as a ferroptosis-related candidate in ocular inflammation.
